fact: The Government of Cabo Verde launched the Portal de Justica on 18 December 2024, offering online land, commercial, vehicle and criminal-record certificates, civil-registry certificates and national ID card renewal, with sign-in through the state Autentika platform.
The Consular Portal, funded by the World Bank Digital Cabo Verde project, digitized consular services for the diaspora and cut processing times for electronic documents by 85%.

The Government of Cabo Verde launched the Foreign Trade Portal on 17 November 2023, with a vehicle-clearance simulator and customs process tracking, as a first step towards about 42 business services online by 2025.
